findings.finding: The opening says “We partly replicated the planning findings” and names Kupzyk (2011). The abstract gives published and reconstructed power contrasts, cluster counts and empirical/exemplary comparisons.

The opening gives the partly replicated verdict, reconstruction scope and power loss estimates before the planning setup. The same paragraph continues with the sample-size and empirical comparison on page 2.
The prose defines formulaic, exemplary and empirical power before comparing them. The worked examples and regeneration appendix identify the calculations and evidence in the paper itself.

The rendered original and reconstructed entries separately state 1.327/1.275, 4.391/4.472, 6.409/6.443, .454/.438, .851/.778, 3.037/3.062, 8/7 and 14/13. Page 1 is byte-equivalent in raster and text to the submitted earlier PR PDF.

The evidence table spans the worked examples, pilot and crossed grids, planning contrasts, checks of the four main result sections and Appendices A–D. The body retains the residual questions on pages 7–9 and separately identifies the current analytical and published model.

The manuscript distinguishes unavailable original fits, seeds and masks from fresh R reconstruction. Page 7 separates unobserved original Monte Carlo variance from the conditional checks. The D.2 discrepancy remains unresolved in the original engine.

Precision and model-fit checks support the interpretation without being treated as the result. The final Appendix D text separates the custom Satterthwaite calculation from the lmerTest implementation used to check it.

The title and first citation identify Kupzyk (2011), and the abstract states the published ranking, lowest ICC, up to eight clusters, and empirical/exemplary ordering. The institutional record links from References on page 12.
The magnitude and direction columns are separate. The note states the rounding tolerances and separates descriptive values from Monte Carlo, mask and reading uncertainty.

The two columns identify each side of the comparison with their own numerical findings. The caption attributes the source side to Kupzyk’s tables and pages, and the reconstruction side to the R analysis.
The rendered Satterthwaite and Kuznetsova citations have active named GoTo destinations for their References entries on page 13.
